column1: # mapping_set_description: "The work vocabulary to Veza's Open Authorization API (OAA) custom application template. Object ids are payload paths as produced by Veza's own SDK (oaaclient 1.2.1); a test builds a payload with the SDK and checks every path exists."

column5: Agents have a native place in OAA.
read -> DataRead; write -> DataWrite; admin -> NonData.
